thread:
alex_support: FYI customer 'acme-corp' reporting users suddenly get 403 on project console after last night's IDP batch push. They say roles were visible yesterday, now broken. Repro steps from customer: log in via SSO -> redirect back to console -> 403. Attached token snippet and repro curl.

jess_acme: Confirmed, happened to 3 devs in different teams. They can list org but any project page returns 403. No UI errors in browser console.

alex_support: Repro curl (redacted creds):
```
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer <id_token>" https://console.redwood.ai/api/v1/projects/ACME-123
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
{"error":"insufficient_scope"}
```

maria_platform: Can you paste the id_token claims (sub, email, groups) redacted? suspect group claim mapping mismatch. Also which IdP — Okta or Azure?

alex_support: IdP: Okta. Token claims (redacted):
`{iss: https://acme.okta.com, sub: 00uabc..., email: jess@acme.com, groups: ["eng-team", "acme_admins"]}`

maria_platform: Console expects canonical group names that map to RBAC bindings: e.g. `ACME-Admins` not `acme_admins`. Did IdP recently add a transform/SCIM rule? @okta-bot did a batch group rename overnight? :thinking_face:

okta-bot: Automated message: bulk group rename job completed 2024-10-12T02:14:05Z. Rule: lowercase_and_underscores -> kebab-case removed.

sam_sre: That would explain it — claim values changed shape so our group-to-role matcher returned no hit and defaulted to deny. Quick mitigation: add a fallback mapping in platform to accept lower_snake -> normalized kebab for the migration window. I can patch a runtime mapping in ~20m.

maria_platform: Also ask customer to try explicit invite using org-admin flow as temporary workaround (invite by email) — will bypass group-derived role for that user.

jess_acme: I can try invite route but need to coordinate with our Org admin, doing now. Will report back.

alex_support: Action items: 1) @sam_sre to push mapping hotfix (runtime) 2) @maria_platform to verify RBAC mappings and add regression test for group-normalization 3) customer follow up on manual invite. Logged as INC-2024-1092.

sam_sre: Pushed hotfix: added snake_case and lowercase acceptance in group matching, deployed to prod canary. Monitor metrics for authorization errors.

alex_support: Customer confirmed one user can access projects after invite, others still blocked until they SSO again. Jess will force logout/login.

maria_platform: We'll add an eval in CI to simulate claim shapes from Okta and Azure so this doesn't regress.

alex_support: Marking this thread resolved once all affected users confirm. Thanks team :raised_hands: 

jess_acme: Access restored for 2/3 devs after logout/login. Waiting on last user who had browser cached session.

alex_support: Closing after last user confirms; root cause: Okta bulk group rename + missing claim-normalization in our matcher. Postmortem planned.
